When Sacred Flame's Blessing is active, dealing Normal Attack or Charged Attack DMG will extend the Blessing's duration by 2s. This extension can occur once every 1s, with the maximum extension being 6s. Additionally, the Sacred Flame's Blessing effects increase by 50% when the character is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state. The Blessing's duration will not decrease if the character is off-field.
